ordered_diagnoses: Squamous cell carcinoma of the trachea

s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute respiratory symptoms with obstructing tracheal mass
salient_findings: Polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Mass causing obstruction of main bronchi
key_facts: 48-year-old white man
Lifelong non-smoker
Remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier
Three-month history of mild hemoptysis and cough
Non-tender subcutaneous mass on left forearm
Normal vital signs
Oxygen saturation of 94% on room air
Normal complete blood count, liver and renal function tests, and coagulation profile
Chest CT scan showed polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Flexible bronchoscopy revealed mass arising from anterior tracheal wall
Mass caused 80% obstruction of right main bronchus and 70% obstruction of left main bronchus

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: No specific evidence of salivary gland origin or perineural invasion

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma of the trachea
rejected.why: Patient is a lifelong non-smoker and no evidence of squamous cell carcinoma histology

rejected.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
rejected.why: No evidence of mucus production or epidermoid differentiation in tumor histology

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: Tumor histology does not show characteristic inflammatory cell infiltrate

rejected.label: Tracheal metastasis from distant site
rejected.why: No evidence of primary tumor at distant site

rejected.label: Granular cell tumor
rejected.why: Tumor histology does not show characteristic granular cell morphology

rejected.label: Chondroid hamartoma
rejected.why: Tumor histology does not show characteristic cartilaginous components
